input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds us; § 14.16 expressly preserves each party's freedom of action. The only restriction on our activities is the § 14.11 bar on reselling the Services, which is a scope-of-use limit rather than a restraint on our business lines and does not engage this rule.

input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: There is no exclusivity, sole-supplier or "all requirements" obligation on us; charges are for Services ordered under Order Forms and § 14.16 confirms each party may contract with others. We remain free to buy from other suppliers.

input.quote: Charges for applicable Services will be specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms.
input.rationale: No most-favoured-nation or price-matching obligation runs against us anywhere in the pricing terms; pricing is set by Service Option Attachments and Order Forms, with IBM price changes only after 12 months on 90 days' notice and a fee-free exit if we disagree (§ 13.1). Nothing to redline.

input.quote: Each party is responsible for the supervision, direction, and control of its respective personnel. IBM reserves the right to determine the assignment of its personnel.
input.rationale: Section 14.8 (Personnel) contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or inducement restriction, and a document-wide search for "solicit" returns nothing. This matches our preferred position of no non-solicit binding us.
